subject.title: [Bug]: exec spawn UNKNOWN after gateway restart — child_process pool not rebuilt

question: Is the current source evidence enough to authorize a fix, or should maintainers require live Windows current-main proof before repair?
rationale: The report describes a serious exec outage, but the stated pool root cause is contradicted by current source and the platform trigger has not been reproduced on current main.

options.title: Require live Windows proof
options.body: Collect a redacted Windows current-main restart-and-exec transcript or recording before choosing the repair layer.

options.title: Split retry hardening
options.body: Track transient Windows `UNKNOWN` spawn retry hardening separately while leaving this issue for the restart trigger.

options.title: Close after stale window
options.body: If no current-main Windows reproduction appears after the normal stale window, close as insufficiently reproducible.

recommendation.title: Require live Windows proof
recommendation.body: Collect a redacted Windows current-main restart-and-exec transcript or recording before choosing the repair layer.

likelyOwner.reason: The spawn retry helper is central to the remaining narrow hardening path, and this person authored the current fallback helper.
